name: s1-safety-path
description: S1. Mrs. Alder calls from her known number and presses 1 when asked whether anyone is hurt. She hears the emergency advice (hang up and call your local emergency number, 911 in the US) and the offer to end the call or stay on, presses 1 to end, and hears the goodbye; hh-hotline-main then disconnects her without a transfer. The disconnect itself is not an event the pinned flow-cli observes (FlowActionStarted covers Lambda, queue transfer, hours check and Lex only), so the goodbye prompt is the last observation and the test ends there (endTest defaults to true). No substitution: the path reaches no hours check and no queue.

steps.contains: please hang up now and call your local emergency number
